records.central_bank: Banque de la République du Burundi
records.years: Governor of the central bank 1992-1998; sitting on Interbank Burundi's board at 31 December 2022 and still at 14 March 2025
records.move: Governor, Banque de la République du Burundi (1992-1998), later a member of the board of directors of Interbank Burundi SA, chairing its audit committee (2022) and its credit committee (2025)
records.summary: Mathias Sinamenye ran Burundi's central bank, the Banque de la République du Burundi, from 1992 to 1998. Interbank Burundi's own 2022 annual report lists him on the bank's board of directors as 'Mathias Sinamenye, Président du Comité d'Audit', the director who chairs the committee overseeing the bank's audits; the bank's 2024 annual report still lists him on the board, as 'Président du Comité Crédit', the committee that oversees lending. The same 2022 annual report states who owns the bank: 'L'actionnariat est, depuis le début, totalement privé' (the shareholding has been entirely private from the start), made up of 'Burundais et d'étrangers, résidents et non résidents, de plus de dix nationalités, avec participation des salariés', and the report calls Interbank 'une des pionnières dans le domaine des banques privées au Burundi' (one of the pioneers among private banks in Burundi). So the same person held the top job at the public central bank and then sat on the board of a bank the bank itself describes as wholly privately held.
records.source_title: Interbank Burundi SA, Rapport annuel 2022 (Conseil d'administration listing and Actionnariat section); governorship dates from Wikipedia, 'Mathias Sinamenye'

held.why_held: No published career history found for any BDCB official. Baiduri Bank Group's own board page and its 2022 corporate governance disclosure give director biographies but none mentions BDCB or AMBD employment, and neither states Baiduri's shareholders. The asiaasset report on Rashidah Sabtu's promotion to managing director gives only her prior BDCB post, no earlier employer.

The BCC 2023 annual report names the full Conseil d'administration and comité de direction but publishes no biography or career history for any of them. No Comorian commercial bank leadership page with biographies was found. Ownership statements are available in the BCC report and in Financial Afrik (AFG Bank Comores 'acquise par le groupe panafricain Atlantic Financial Group en octobre 2020'; Exim Bank Comores a 'filiale d'Exim Bank Tanzania'), so only the career link is missing.

Governor Ahmed Osman Ali's pre-central-bank employers are not stated in any source opened. Financial Afrik's 2025 interview gives only his university; Central Banking's Central Bank of Djibouti page gives his term start (8 May 2018) and staff contact names with no roles or career histories.

Three BRH careers were read in full and none includes a private financial employer. Charles Castel (World Bank expert page): BRH from 1995, plus the Haitian Privatization Commission, Ministry of Commerce, EDH, UNDP and the State University, all public. Bonivert Claude (Wikipedia): BNRH/BRH from 1966, governor 1991-1994, with a school and an accountants' body outside. Sogebank's 2023-2024 annual report names its whole board and senior management but publishes no career histories and no shareholder list.

No National Bank of Cambodia career found on a private bank's board. Cambodia Post Bank's board page gives nine full biographies and none mentions the National Bank of Cambodia, and the page states no shareholders. ACLEDA Bank's ownership IS already stated on its own shareholder page as at 20 August 2024 — 'AFT 28.0564%', 'SMBC 18.0669%', 'Public Shareholders 17.6828%', 'COFIBRED 12.1271%', 'ORIX 12.1271%' — so only a named ACLEDA director or manager with a prior NBC post is missing; ACLEDA's annual report board-biography pages would settle it.

searched_no_result: Banque Centrale des Comores, Rapport Annuel 2023 — read the 'Conseil d'administration au 31 décembre 2023', 'Gouvernement et comité de direction' and 'Comité d'audit' listings plus the banking-sector section: names only, explicitly no biographies or career histories.
Baiduri Bank Group, 'Our Leadership — Board of Directors' page — read all six director biographies: no AMBD or BDCB employment; no ownership statement on the page.

Baiduri Bank, Corporate Governance Disclosure 2022 (PDF) — read the board composition list and senior-management-committee section: directors named with independence status only, no biographies, no shareholder statement.
Asia Asset Management, 'Brunei Darussalam Central Bank names Rashidah Sabtu as managing director' — read the whole item: only her BDCB deputy managing director post, no earlier employer.

Financial Afrik, 'Entretien exclusif avec Ahmed Osman Ali, gouverneur de la Banque Centrale de Djibouti' (16 April 2025) — read the biographical lead-in: education only ('Diplômé de l'Université François Rabelais de Tours'), no prior employers.
Central Banking, Central Bank of Djibouti institution page — read the governor and staff-contacts section: term start 8 May 2018, four staff contacts, no career histories.

Wikipedia, 'Bonivert Claude' — read the full career section: BNRH/BRH 1966 onward, board membership 1982 and 1985-86, governor 1991-1994; the only non-state roles are the EFCTEC school and the OCPAH accountants' body, neither a financial firm.

World Bank Live, 'Charles Castel' expert biography — read the full career listing: BRH from 1995 to governor in 2007, Haitian Privatization Commission, Ministry of Commerce, EDH, UNDP, State University of Haiti; no private bank.

Le Nouvelliste, 'Installation of the new Board of Directors of the BRH' — read the full item: the five board members are named (Ronald Gabriel, Guerly Leriche, Florient Jean Mari, Michèle Delerme, Edwige Jean) with no career histories.
Sogebank, Rapport Annuel 2023-2024 — read the Conseil d'Administration and Hauts Cadres listings: twelve directors and twenty-two senior managers named, no career histories, no shareholder table.
Cambodia Post Bank, 'Board of Directors' page — read all nine biographies: none mentions the National Bank of Cambodia; page states no shareholders.
ACLEDA Securities, 'Facts & Figures — Corporate Governance' page — read the AGM resolutions section: names the chairman (Chhay Soeun) and a director (Kyosuke Hattori) with no biographies.

BCAB (Banque Communautaire et Agricole du Burundi), 'Notre équipe de direction' — read all thirteen management biographies: prior employers are CRDB, BBCI, KCB, Diamond Trust Bank, BANCOBU, Ecobank, Interbank and ministries; no BRB career.

Interbank Burundi, Rapport annuel 2024 — read the 'Conseil d'administration au 14 mars 2025' and 'Comité de direction' listings and the capital section: names only, no biographies, no shareholder percentages.

Financial Afrik, 'Comores: le réveil bancaire d'un archipel de la zone franc' (3 September 2026) — read the whole article: bank ownership described for AFG Bank Comores and Exim Bank Comores, no executives named and no career histories.
